about.title: About Buloqboshi Sanatorium
about.description: Located at an altitude of 1,300 meters above sea level in the city of Parkent. We offer clean mountain air, professional doctors, and over 40 types of procedures.
about.sub_description: A unique place combining treatment and relaxation. Ideal for restoring the body and strengthening health in a calm mountain atmosphere.

why_us.title: Why choose us?
items: Team of professional doctors with many years of experience
Treatment, relaxation, and recovery in one place

our_goal.title: Our goal
our_goal.description1: To create an opportunity for healing and recovery based on an individual approach to each client. We help not only to treat diseases but also to fully restore the body through modern physiotherapy methods, experienced doctors, and a comfortable environment.
our_goal.description2: The most important result for us is the improvement of your health, getting rid of pain, and returning to daily life with energy. Each program is developed based on your condition and aimed at maximum effectiveness.
our_goal.cta: Invest in your health today — contact us and start your individual treatment program!

items.question: What diseases are treated in Buloqboshi Sanatorium?
items.answer: The sanatorium offers effective treatments for the musculoskeletal system, nervous system, cardiovascular diseases, and general recovery. Contact us now to find the right treatment course for you!

items.question: Is advance booking required?
items.answer: Yes, our sanatorium has 80 seats, but due to limited space, advance booking is highly recommended. Reserve your spot today — don't be late!

items.question: How long does the treatment last?
items.answer: The minimum stay is 5 days, but for most of our clients, a 7–14 day course gives the optimal result. Get a free consultation to determine which course is right for you!

items.question: What procedures are available?
items.answer: Electrophoresis, ultrasound, darsonval, inhalation, magnetotherapy, hydromassage, hijama, leech therapy, acupuncture, and other modern physiotherapy methods are used. Contact us for the full list of treatments!

items.question: Will there be a doctor's examination?
items.answer: Yes, every patient undergoes an individual examination, and a personal treatment plan is created. There is also a pharmacy with affordable prices inside the sanatorium. Sign up now for an individual approach!

items.question: How is the catering organized?
items.answer: Our sanatorium serves 3 hot meals a day: 2 types of liquid and solid dishes, salads, fruits, and sweets. Healthy and balanced nutrition is available, including dietary menus if needed. Start your healthy holiday today!

items.question: What do the prices depend on?
items.answer: Prices depend on the room equipment, size, volume, as well as living conditions and the treatment course. Contact us to find out the exact price!

items.question: Is family vacation possible?
items.answer: Yes, the sanatorium is very convenient for family holidays with children, parents, and grandparents. Plan a healthy vacation with your family!

items.question: What documents are needed?
items.answer: It is recommended to bring your passport and any existing medical documents. Start your registration now!

items.question: What additional services are available?
items.answer: Eco-tourism and pilgrimage tourism are established. Every weekend, free trips are organized by special transport with guides to attractions such as Sukok and Kumushkon mountains, Hazrat Ali and Zarkent shrines, and the Sun Museum.

items.question: Are there cultural events?
items.answer: Yes, in our sanatorium, concerts of national and pop singers, live performances, humorous shows, dance and poetry evenings are organized every other day.

items.question: How can I contact you?
items.answer: You can contact us quickly via phone or Telegram. Call now or write on Telegram. Places fill up fast — catch yours!

mini_services.title: Our services
mini_services.subtitle: Buloqboshi Sanatorium offers modern and effective treatments to restore and strengthen your health. We offer medical diagnostics, physiotherapy, herbal medicine, hydrotherapy, and various massage services. Our highly qualified doctors provide services based on an individual approach to help improve your health.

physio_services.title: Physiotherapy Treatments
physio_services.subtitle: Physiotherapy is a set of modern and safe procedures that help restore the body without or with minimal medication. They improve blood circulation, reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and accelerate the natural healing process of tissues.

items.title: Electrophoresis
items.desc: Delivers medication directly to the affected area using an electric current.

items.title: Darsonval
items.desc: Affects the body through a high-frequency current.

items.title: Ultrasound Therapy
items.desc: Affects deep tissues through ultrasound waves.

items.title: Inhalation
items.desc: Medications are delivered to the respiratory tract in the form of steam or aerosol.

items.title: UHF Therapy
items.desc: Treatment with a high-frequency electromagnetic field.

items.title: Magnetotherapy
items.desc: Affects using a low-frequency magnetic field.

items.title: Nuga Best Apparatus
items.desc: Works on the spine through infrared heat and mechanical impact.

items.title: Spinal Traction Device
items.desc: Careful stretching of the spine on a special equipment.

items.title: Salt Cave (Halochamber)
items.desc: Has a positive effect on the respiratory system through a salty environment.

items.title: Vibromassage
items.desc: Affects muscles and tissues through vibration.

items.title: Ozonotherapy
items.desc: Treatment with oxygen enriched with ozone.

items.title: Laser Therapy
items.desc: Treatment with a low-intensity laser beam.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Our sanatorium is an ideal place not only for improving your health, but also for active recreation and new adventures. Here you can do the following activities:

items.title: Treatment - Strengthening Health
items.desc: In our sanatorium, professional doctors offer more than 40 different procedures:
list: Physiotherapy – treatment of the body with physiotherapy equipment
Hydrotherapy – mineral baths and shower procedures
Massages – relaxation of muscles and joints
Ultrasound and diagnostics – timely detection and prevention of diseases
items.footer: If you want to get rid of a specific disease or fatigue, effective health programs await you in our sanatorium!

items.title: Relaxation - a quiet pastime among the mountains
items.desc: "Buloqboshi Sanatorium" is famous for its clean mountain air and offers guests a comfortable and relaxing holiday:
list: Walking in nature – relief from stress and a boost of energy
Relaxing on the trestle beds – enjoying the clean air and sun rays
Sauna and swimming pool – a great place for physical and mental relaxation
Billiards and table tennis – fun with friends
items.footer: If you dream of escaping from the noise and enjoying the silence, our sanatorium is the perfect place for this!

items.title: Nordic walking
items.desc: Nordic walking is a step towards health. An excellent choice for those who want to have an active rest in nature!
list: Increase physical activity and maintain a healthy lifestyle
Feeling of vigor and a surge of energy thanks to walks in the fresh air
Learning the correct walking technique from experienced instructors
items.footer: If you are looking for a healthy activity, do not miss this opportunity!

items.title: Marathons - physical activity and sport
items.desc: Marathons for sports enthusiasts are organized in "Buloqboshi Sanatorium":
list: Running on mountain trails – strengthening the body
Team sports marathons – active time with friends and new acquaintances
Discovery of new places and routes
items.footer: Do you love sports and want to direct your energy in the right direction? Join our marathons!

items.title: Pilgrimage and ECO tours - offering unforgettable moments
items.footer: Buloqboshi Sanatorium invites you to relax and find spiritual peace!

top_activities.title: Hijama and Leech therapy
top_activities.desc: Hijama and leech therapy at "Buloqboshi Sanatorium" is a unique way of healing the body. This ancient therapy helps to deeply clean the blood vessels, restore energy balance, remove toxins, relax muscles, and improve blood circulation.
benefits: Effective fight against stress and fatigue

top_activities.title: Hydromassage
top_activities.desc: Hydromassage in "Buloqboshi Sanatorium" is one of the most effective procedures for relaxing the body, improving blood circulation and softening muscle tissue. Treatment is carried out using special water flows.
benefits: Relaxation of muscles and reduction of pain
Improvement of blood circulation and lymphatic system
Increased skin elasticity and cell renewal

top_activities.title: Cedar barrel
top_activities.desc: Cedar Barrel in Buloqboshi Sanatorium is a natural steam therapy for cleansing the body of toxins, strengthening the immune system and improving overall health. Mini-sauna made of natural cedar envelops the body in warm steam, stimulating the removal of harmful substances and accelerating metabolism.
benefits: Removal of toxins and harmful substances
Normalizing weight and rejuvenating the skin

services.massage_services_title: Massage services - for your health and well-being
services.massage_services_subtitle: "Buloqboshi Sanatorium" offers professional massage services to restore the body, relax muscles and improve overall well-being. Each treatment is carried out individually and is recommended depending on your health condition.

massage_services.title: Vacuum Cupping Massage
massage_services.desc: An effective procedure that helps improve blood circulation, relax muscles, and remove toxins using vacuum suction.

massage_services.title: Hydromassage
massage_services.desc: The effect on the skin and muscle tissue using special water streams reduces stress, improves blood circulation and relieves fatigue.

massage_services.title: Acupuncture
massage_services.desc: Impact on acupuncture points regulates the flow of energy in the body, improves the functioning of internal organs and reduces pain.

massage_services.title: Honey Massage
massage_services.desc: Massage using pure honey applied to the body deeply relaxes muscles, reduces inflammation, helps relieve stress, and provides a pleasant feeling of lightness.

massage_services.title: Classic massage
massage_services.desc: The most recommended type of massage to improve muscle tone, relieve fatigue and improve overall health.

massage_services.title: Manual therapy
massage_services.desc: Special techniques of manual manipulation of the spine and joints to improve mobility and reduce pain.
